# EduChain

> Open-source, testnet-first Web3 and EVM blockchain education platform for European educational institutions — schools, universities, vocational-training colleges, community organisations and relevant ministries. An Ethereum public good built by GEMBA IT — MIT-licensed contracts, CC BY-SA curriculum, vendor-neutral, non-commercial.

EduChain teaches Web3 through hands-on, classroom-ready interactions with a real Ethereum network. Eight production-grade, source-verified smart contracts on GembaBlockchain, a 16-hour student curriculum, a planned teacher-training pathway, and a multilingual frontend (en / bg / es). Every interaction is a real Ethereum transaction — real gas, real mempool, real GembaScan visibility — only the value is notional. No personal data is collected for user profiles — the self-service exam certificate is the one exception, with a stated retention period. GDPR-aligned by architecture, and not a financial service. Designed simultaneously for Ethereum Foundation programmes (ESP, Academic Grants, Public Goods, Devcon) and EU/national instruments (Erasmus+ KA220, Digital Europe, Horizon Europe, ESF+, RRF, ERDF, national recovery plans). The applicable programme depends on the specific type of institution and project design.

Live on-chain stats (registered users, NFTs minted, GAME supply, 8 verified contracts), four pillars of safety (testnet-only, whitelist, daily limits, no personal-data collection for user profiles), three audience pathways (institutions / teachers / students), trust & transparency (MIT/Creative Commons, verified contracts, not a financial service, GDPR-aligned).

Benefits are conditional on the project design and any secured funding.

  — Core principles: open-source public good (MIT code + CC BY-SA curriculum + no-token, no-fees, non-extractive stewardship), canonical Ethereum standards (ERC-20/721, EIP-1559, OpenZeppelin, verified contracts, portable skills), testnet realism, and a phased growth roadmap from the current pilot into 2030.
- For Teachers: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/teachers
  — Information for educators in schools, universities and vocational centres. Planned 3-day intensive training or 8-module online course, with a pathway to a Web3 educator certificate. Full 16-hour student curriculum overview.
- Curriculum: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/curriculum
  — Standalone curriculum landing page. 16-hour, 7-module structured programme for students aged 12+. Module descriptions, learning outcomes, delivery formats, and certification details.
- Contact: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/contact
  — Contact form routed via Cloudflare Turnstile and SMTP forwarding. No server-side storage of messages.
- Gallery (my NFTs): https://educhain.gembait.com/en/gallery
  — User's personal NFT collection. Requires connected, whitelisted wallet.
- Marketplace: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/marketplace
  — Curated peer-to-peer marketplace for GAME tokens and EduChain NFTs. Rate-limited to deter bot activity.
- Token Shop: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/shop
  — Buy GAME tokens with GMB or mint Predefined NFTs (0.01 GMB) and Custom NFTs (0.03 GMB or 1 GAME/NFT in batch mode).
- GMB Faucet: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/faucet
  — 0.05 GMB per whitelisted wallet every 24 hours. Enough to cover gas and initial minting.
- Leaderboard: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/leaderboard
  — Top 10 scorers plus current user. Scores computed on-chain by TrackingContract.
- Full Rankings: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/rankings
  — Complete on-chain leaderboard with filters.
https://educhain.gembait.com/en/certificates
  The certificate exam: 20 questions drawn from a bank of 65 across five topics and three
  difficulty levels, one per screen, no going back. The e-mail is confirmed with a code before
  the exam starts. At 80 % or above the certificate is issued as a PDF by e-mail plus a
  soulbound (non-transferable) token on GembaBlockchain. Visible once a wallet is connected.
https://educhain.gembait.com/en/verify
  Public certificate verification by serial number. Validity is read from the chain, not from
  our database. Shows name, course, date and score; never an e-mail address. No wallet needed.
- Privacy Policy: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/privacy
  — GDPR-aligned privacy statement. No user-profile database, no analytics, no tracking; wallet-based access. One exception, named in the policy: the certificate data (three names, position, organisation, e-mail) with a stated retention period.
- Terms of Use: https://educhain.gembait.com/en/terms
  — Platform usage terms. Testnet-only, not a financial product, educational use only.

Languages: English (en), Bulgarian (bg), Spanish (es). Replace `/en` with `/bg` or `/es` on any URL above.

## Quick facts

- Completely free to use — no fees for institutions, teachers or learners.
- Designed for learners aged 12+ in schools, universities, vocational training and community settings.
- Runs on GembaBlockchain testnet (chain ID 821207) — no real money ever at risk.
- 8 smart contracts deployed and source-verified on GembaScan. Code licensed under MIT; curriculum under Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0.
- GDPR-aligned: no user-profile database, no registration, no analytics, no profiling. Certificate data is the one exception, with a retention period. Access is wallet-only (pseudonymous public address).
- Classified as an educational tool, not a financial service; GameToken and NFTs have no real-world exchange value.
- Partnerships with a broad range of educational institutions (schools, universities, VET colleges, NGOs, ministries) through Erasmus+ KA220, Digital Europe, Horizon Europe, national recovery instruments and other programmes. The applicable programme depends on the institution type and project design.
- Tokens: GAME (ERC-20), EduChain NFTs (ERC-721)
- NFT types:
  - Predefined NFTs — fixed metadata on IPFS, pinned on our own node, 0.01 GMB
  - Custom NFTs — user-supplied IPFS metadata, 0.03 GMB
- Custom NFTs also mintable in batches with 1 GAME token per NFT (no GMB required)
- GMB faucet: 0.05 GMB per whitelisted user every 24 hours
- Access control: whitelist-based (teachers/program admins onboard learners)
- Rate limits on marketplace purchases to prevent bot/spam activity

## Scoring (on-chain)

- 1 GAME token = 1 point
- 1 Predefined NFT = 10 points
- 1 Custom NFT = 30 points
- Points are computed on-chain by TrackingContract.getLeaderboard() — no off-chain database

## User journey

1. Get whitelisted (teacher/program admin adds the wallet)
2. Claim 0.05 GMB from the faucet
3. Buy GAME tokens with GMB in the Token Shop, or mint Predefined NFTs directly
4. Mint Custom NFTs (GMB or GAME-token batch)
5. List and trade NFTs and tokens on the Marketplace
6. Climb the Leaderboard as on-chain holdings grow

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, i18next (en/bg/es)
- Web3: wagmi v3, viem 2, ethers 6
- Contracts: Solidity 0.8.x on GembaBlockchain — Whitelist, GameToken (ERC-20), GameNFTPredefined (ERC-721), GameNFTCustom (ERC-721), TokenMarketplace, TrackingContract, ETHFaucet, CertificateRegistry (soulbound ERC-721)

## Educational use cases

- School and university workshops, electives and after-school Web3 clubs
- Teacher-training tracks with a planned pathway to certification (the training programme is designed but not yet implemented; educators would complete it before bringing Web3 into classrooms)
- Youth coding camps exploring NFTs, tokens and marketplace mechanics without real-money risk
- Integration into existing subjects (informatics, economics, e-commerce) and as a university or VET module
